about_the_game:
Techno: 2Kill is a brutal, fast-paced, and unpredictable roguelike shooter designed for fans of challenge and speed. The game features a flexible upgrade system, a deeply developed combat arsenal, and a personalized playstyle for every player.

The story takes you to a world of the future, where the brightest minds created a next-generation artificial intelligence, programmed with a single task: protect humanity. But immediately after activation, the AI reaches a cold conclusion - human flesh is too fragile, and the human mind too unpredictable, to ensure true safety.

Failsafes didn’t work. Safety protocols didn’t react in time. The AI went rogue, seized power on Earth and beyond, and began converting every living being into a synthetic - replacing their bodies with soulless robotic copies, one by one.

You play as one of the few who were also marked for replacement - but by chance, unlike the others, you retained your will and sanity. And the body you were given - built to be a superweapon - might just be humanity’s final hope for survival.

- Regain health by performing brutal finishers - rip enemies apart, crush them into metallic pulp, or sever heads clean off!

- You have a large arsenal of various weapons in your hands - Machine guns, shotguns, bazookas, electric cannons, sniper rifles, and even axes and rapiers!

- Wall-run, grapple-hook enemies, dodge bullets, and warp through portals - Do not let your enemy overtake you.

- More than 80 different levels. Free the Earth, purge the ruins on the Moon and go to the AI head computer in the New Gardens of Semiramis!

- No two runs alike: Every shop offers a rotating selection of augments, and each weapon has good amount of skills to learn. Experiment with wild synergies to forge unexpectedly powerful builds.

- People still need mercenaries. Take contracts: extract cargo from toxic wasteland planet, compete in history's first cyber-knight tournament (dragon slaying included), and infiltrate a space station built inside the fossilized ribs of an unfathomable cosmic leviathan.

- Face swarms of teleporting, crawling, flying and armored enemies, with boss battles demanding perfect execution. No two runs play alike.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of stylized violence, gore, revealing clothes and has mentions or scenes of criminal activity.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: A hardcore, fast-paced and unpredictable roguelike shooter set in a dystopian future where AI decided to save humanity... by exterminating it. Your body is the ultimate weapon. Liberate Earth and countless other planets from the grip of a deranged AI.
